message.content: In the discussion regarding the garage sale, RexxarRemar suggests two ideas to make the event more engaging. First, he proposes adding decorations to brighten up the atmosphere and make the garage sale more inviting. Second, RexxarRemar recommends brainstorming ideas for decorations together, noting that a little effort could significantly improve the overall experience. Additionally, RexxarRemar suggests thinking about decorations that could also serve a practical purpose, such as providing shade during the event.
